NOCTUA 1.0.0 - see your MediatR codebase.

Usage: cqrslens <path> [options]

Report
  -o, --output FILE         Report path. Default: ARCHITECTURE.md (.html or .json) in the current
                            directory.
  --format FORMAT           md (default), html, json, or agent. A matching -o extension implies the
                            format.
  --render MODE             HTML diagrams: mermaid (default) or svg (zero-JS inline SVG).
  --export-svg DIR          Also write every diagram as a standalone .svg file into DIR (created
                            when missing).
  --export-mermaid DIR      Also write every diagram as a standalone .mmd file into DIR (created
                            when missing).
  --summary FILE            Also write a compact Markdown job summary.
  --generated-at ISO8601    Fixed timestamp for reproducible reports; timing is reported as 0 ms.

Analysis
  --analysis MODE           text (default) or roslyn (opt-in).
  --slice FILTER            Trace vertical slices matching FILTER (endpoint, request, handler,
                            entity, or event). Streams to stdout when -o is omitted.
  --markers LIST            Extra request roots, e.g. ICommand,IQuery,IMessage. Requests behind
                            interfaces deriving from IRequest are always followed.
  --handler-markers LIST    Extra handler roots for external wrappers, e.g.
                            ICommandHandler,IQueryHandler.
  --cqrs-map-split MODE     count (default), feature, or unsplit. Overrides the cqrsMapSplit config
                            key.
  --config FILE             Config file. Default: <path>/.cqrslens.json when present. Holds
                            analysis, render, watermark, markers, layers, and rules.

Checks and CI
  --strict                  Exit 4 when architecture checks report an error and the scan is
                            complete.
  --baseline FILE           Compare checks with a baseline; --strict then fails only on new errors.
  --write-baseline FILE     Re
[truncated]
